intro: We at Bali Yoga School are offering 100 hours hatha/ vinyasa flow / Ashtanga based yoga teacher training. It is a self-paced yoga course where you get minimum 30 days to maximum 3 months to complete this course. The course includes pre-recorded yoga sessions on each topic of each subject with clear explanation and demonstration. You can play all the classes even in low internet speed.

100 hours yoga course is part of 200 hours yoga course. It's for those who don't want to complete the 200 hours in one time, so we give them an option to complete 200 hours in two parts, first semester and 2nd semester. After completing the 1st 100 hours you can join us any time to complete the 2nd 100 hours program to get the certification of the 200 hours yoga teacher training course.

In case you would like to complete the 2nd 100 hours in school premises instead of online at Bali Yoga School, we are giving you that option too; you can choose yourself whether you want to do the 2nd 100 hours course online or offline.

issues: Page/H1 says the course is 'Yoga Alliance Certified Certification', but Yoga Alliance registers 200/300/500-hour trainings, not 100-hour; the page itself says 100 h is half of the 200 h. Verify certification wording.

No live classes are mentioned on this page, but the online hub (/online-yoga-teacher-training-courses-in-bali/) says Part 1 / 100 Hour students 'have the ability to join live Zoom classes for an entire year'.
Online hub describes Part 2 / 100 Hour as completable 'within 3 to 6 months'; this page says 30 days to 3 months.
Course listing /courses_group/online-yoga-course/ shows this course with '15' (days?) and '$240'; this page states a flexible 30 days–3 months.
Pre-recorded classes are hosted on an external domain (himalayanonlineyogacourses.com) — confirm it is still live.

Syllabus duplicates items (e.g. 'Meditation – Shanti Mantra' on Day 2 and Day 10; 'What is Mantra?' on Day 1 and Day 11); Day 11–15 omit several subjects. Spelling fixed: 'Palvic Gurdel'→'Pelvic Girdle', 'Andr Bahir'→'Antar Bahir'.
Meta description is grammatically broken ('Bali yoga school are offering ...').
Unverified marketing claims not used: 'one of the top yoga school of Bali', 'great teachers', 'teach anywhere in the world'.

'Advantages' list promises 'free lifetime membership with Bali Yoga School & its branches' and opportunities to work as assistant/lead teacher or volunteer — unverifiable perks, not extracted; confirm before use.
